name: race_rival_fell_clear_to_win
description: A Holdfast goes under (design 1.3): team B falls on wave 3 (EV_RACE fell), and team A, which has cleared only two, has not won yet: it wins the moment it clears wave 3 ('Your rival fell on wave 3. Clear wave 3 to win'), however many lives that costs it. If both fall, the later wave wins; on the same wave, more of that wave's creeps killed; then a draw.

steps.msg: both teams are on wave 3, two cleared
team B's Holdfast fell on wave 3

steps.assert: m.decided_by() == '' and not m.over and m.cleared_waves(0) == 2
steps.msg: team A has cleared two: nothing is decided yet

steps.assert: clear3.size() == 1 and scene.decided_tick() == clear3[0]['tick'] and m.teams[0].lives < 20
steps.msg: team A wins the tick it clears wave 3, its leaks notwithstanding
decided by the fall, with no race time
team A falls on wave 2: the later wave wins

steps.assert: m3.teams[0].fell_wave == 1 and m3.teams[1].fell_wave == 1 and m3.teams[0].fell_kills >= 2 and m3.teams[1].fell_kills == 0
steps.msg: both fall on wave 1, team A having killed some of it
on the same wave, more of its creeps killed wins
the same wave and the same kills: a draw
